title: The Great Mixing
statementMd:
Sasha and Kolya decided to get drunk with Coke, again. This time they have $*k*$ types of Coke. $*i*$-th type is characterised by its carbon dioxide concentration ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7223e2da7cf0d001a3a06ab38023d8f967968d61.png). Today, on the party in honour of Sergiy of Vancouver they decided to prepare a glass of Coke with carbon dioxide concentration ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3f84b61691275b2806285c0208e93684ddff5912.png). The drink should also be tasty, so the glass can contain only integer number of liters of each Coke type (some types can be not presented in the glass). Also, they want to minimize the total volume of Coke in the glass.

Carbon dioxide concentration is defined as the volume of carbone dioxide in the Coke divided by the total volume of Coke. When you mix two Cokes, the volume of carbon dioxide sums up, and the total volume of Coke sums up as well.

Help them, find the minimal natural number of liters needed to create a glass with carbon dioxide concentration ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3f84b61691275b2806285c0208e93684ddff5912.png). Assume that the friends have unlimited amount of each Coke type.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$, $*k*$ ($0 ≤ *n* ≤ 1000$, $1 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{6}$) — carbon dioxide concentration the friends want and the number of Coke types.

The second line contains $*k*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*k*}$ ($0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 1000$) — carbon dioxide concentration of each type of Coke. Some Coke types can have same concentration.

## Output

Print the minimal natural number of liter needed to prepare a glass with carbon dioxide concentration ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3f84b61691275b2806285c0208e93684ddff5912.png), or `-1` if it is impossible.

## Note

In the first sample case, we can achieve concentration ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bed0f5c3640139492194728ccc3ac55accf16a8e.png) using one liter of Coke of types ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9b37ab6b0795f08ffcc699d9101a9efb89374478.png) and ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d82574f3d78c4bd9d8ab9bda103e05a51e1b3161.png): ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b23f59a536403f9a2364e971aa0bfc9a3411b366.png).

In the second case, we can achieve concentration ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/46aa9afb7ee4d932ca2c3f0d6535a9955fc8f0a8.png) using two liters of ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/69b8967d23533c2caada3910f564294509450a59.png) type and one liter of ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/abf5cbf9e8a81a0eff83ff53574dcabb097df44e.png) type: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4d2331fc733efc58d37745ff9a495a116ebd7e8a.png).
statementZhMd:
Sasha 和 Kolya 又决定喝可乐喝到醉。这次他们有 $*k*$ 种可乐。第 $*i*$ 种可乐的二氧化碳浓度由 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7223e2da7cf0d001a3a06ab38023d8f967968d61.png) 表示。今天，在庆祝温哥华的 Sergiy 的聚会上，他们决定调制一杯二氧化碳浓度为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3f84b61691275b2806285c0208e93684ddff5912.png) 的可乐。为了保证饮料美味，这杯可乐中每种可乐的体积必须是整数升（某些种类可以不出现）。同时，他们希望使这杯可乐的总体积最小。

二氧化碳浓度定义为可乐中二氧化碳的体积除以可乐的总体积。当混合两种可乐时，二氧化碳的体积相加，可乐的总体积也相加。

请帮助他们求出，为调制一杯二氧化碳浓度为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3f84b61691275b2806285c0208e93684ddff5912.png) 的可乐所需的最小正整数升数。假设朋友们拥有每种可乐的无限供应。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$、$*k*$（$0 ≤ *n* ≤ 1000$，$1 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{6}$）——朋友们希望达到的二氧化碳浓度，以及可乐的种类数。

第二行包含 $*k*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*k*}$（$0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 1000$）——每种可乐的二氧化碳浓度。不同种类的可乐可能具有相同的浓度。

## 输出格式

输出调制一杯二氧化碳浓度为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3f84b61691275b2806285c0208e93684ddff5912.png) 的可乐所需的最小升数；如果无法实现，则输出 `-1`。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，我们可以使用 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9b37ab6b0795f08ffcc699d9101a9efb89374478.png) 和 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d82574f3d78c4bd9d8ab9bda103e05a51e1b3161.png) 两种可乐各一升，得到浓度 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bed0f5c3640139492194728ccc3ac55accf16a8e.png)：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b23f59a536403f9a2364e971aa0bfc9a3411b366.png)。

在第二个样例中，我们可以使用两升 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/69b8967d23533c2caada3910f564294509450a59.png) 类型的可乐和一升 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/abf5cbf9e8a81a0eff83ff53574dcabb097df44e.png) 类型的可乐，得到浓度 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/46aa9afb7ee4d932ca2c3f0d6535a9955fc8f0a8.png)：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4d2331fc733efc58d37745ff9a495a116ebd7e8a.png)。
